name: zturret_fire_weapon_callback
description: zTurret_Runtime::FireWeaponCallback is the zEffectAnim on-state-done callback that forwards the runtime user pointer to FireWeapon.
known_limits: tier S verification was not attempted in this session; defer to a coherent zTurret class/source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x437e50 validates the fastcall callback ABI: ECX carries the ignored animation entry, EDX carries the zTurret_Runtime pointer, the stack event code is ignored, and the function forwards to zTurret_Runtime::FireWeapon.
